update_policy.purpose: Keep SkillScout aligned with Codex plugin, skill, app, and MCP changes.
recommended_review_triggers: Plugin rename, removal, or capability change
New MCP server type becomes commonly available
maintenance_notes: Prefer category-level guidance when exact plugin availability is uncertain.
Review examples after major Codex plugin updates.
Update Chinese explanations when category behavior changes.

categories.plain_english_description: General coding, refactoring, local repository work, and command-line development.
categories.chinese_description: 用于写代码、重构、本地仓库修改和命令行开发。
when_not_to_use: The task is only writing text
The user only needs a recommendation
categories.risk_of_overuse: May be unnecessary for pure planning, translation, or short writing tasks.

categories.plain_english_description: Repository hosting, issues, pull requests, branches, and remote collaboration.
categories.chinese_description: 用于 GitHub 仓库、Issue、PR、分支和远程协作。
when_not_to_use: No remote repository action is needed
categories.risk_of_overuse: Adds account and permission complexity when local edits are enough.

categories.plain_english_description: Browser inspection, web app testing, screenshots, and live page debugging.
categories.chinese_description: 用于浏览器检查、网页测试、截图和前端调试。
categories.risk_of_overuse: Can slow down simple code edits that do not require visual verification.

categories.plain_english_description: Reading, editing, organizing, and exporting local document files.
categories.chinese_description: 用于读取、编辑、整理和导出本地文档文件。
categories.risk_of_overuse: May be unnecessary for short text generated directly in chat.

categories.plain_english_description: PDF extraction, conversion, watermarking, merging, splitting, and form handling.
categories.chinese_description: 用于 PDF 提取、转换、加水印、合并、拆分和表单处理。
when_not_to_use: The source is plain text or DOCX
categories.risk_of_overuse: Do not use PDF tools for documents that can be edited directly.

categories.plain_english_description: Presentation and slide deck creation, editing, and export.
categories.chinese_description: 用于创建、编辑和导出演示文稿。
when_not_to_use: The deliverable is a document or web page
categories.risk_of_overuse: Slides add design overhead when a simple document would work.

categories.plain_english_description: Spreadsheet analysis, formulas, charts, cleaning, and workbook creation.
categories.chinese_description: 用于表格分析、公式、图表、数据清洗和工作簿创建。
categories.risk_of_overuse: Can be too heavy for small lists or simple arithmetic.

categories.plain_english_description: Image generation, editing, background removal, and visual asset creation.
categories.chinese_description: 用于图片生成、编辑、去背景和视觉素材制作。
when_not_to_use: Existing brand assets must not be altered
categories.risk_of_overuse: Generated images can distract from tasks that only need code or writing.

categories.plain_english_description: Video scripting, animation, captions, voiceover, rendering, and web-to-video workflows.
categories.chinese_description: 用于视频脚本、动画、字幕、配音、渲染和网页转视频工作流。
when_not_to_use: The deliverable is only a static image, document, or website
example_tasks: Turn a website into a short promo
categories.risk_of_overuse: Video workflows are heavy; avoid them when a still image, slide, or short text is enough.

categories.plain_english_description: Figma design inspection, UI generation, design systems, and design-to-code workflows.
categories.chinese_description: 用于 Figma 设计读取、UI 生成、设计系统和设计转代码流程。
when_not_to_use: A simple UI can be built directly
categories.risk_of_overuse: Adds design tooling complexity when the project has no design source.

categories.plain_english_description: Email search, drafting, sending, and inbox workflows.
categories.chinese_description: 用于邮件搜索、起草、发送和收件箱工作流。
when_not_to_use: No email account action is needed
categories.risk_of_overuse: Creates privacy and permission concerns when a template is enough.

categories.plain_english_description: Scheduling, event lookup, meeting planning, and calendar updates.
categories.chinese_description: 用于日程安排、会议查询、会议计划和日历更新。
when_not_to_use: Only a written plan is needed
categories.risk_of_overuse: Unneeded for static plans or reminders handled elsewhere.

categories.plain_english_description: Contact lookup, relationship context, and address book workflows.
categories.chinese_description: 用于联系人查询、人际关系上下文和通讯录工作流。
when_not_to_use: The user provides all contact details
categories.risk_of_overuse: May introduce privacy risk for simple manual contact lists.

categories.plain_english_description: Google Drive or other cloud file lookup, sharing, export, and organization.
categories.chinese_description: 用于 Google Drive 等云端文件查找、共享、导出和整理。
when_not_to_use: No connected cloud account is needed
categories.risk_of_overuse: Adds account dependency when local upload or text input is simpler.

categories.plain_english_description: Recurring tasks, scheduled checks, reminders, and monitors.
categories.chinese_description: 用于定时任务、提醒、监控和自动化流程。
categories.risk_of_overuse: Recurring automation is unnecessary for one-off tasks.

categories.plain_english_description: External Model Context Protocol servers that expose tools, data, or systems to Codex.
categories.chinese_description: 用于连接通过 MCP 暴露给 Codex 的外部工具、数据或系统。
categories.risk_of_overuse: Can add setup and security overhead without a concrete integration need.

categories.plain_english_description: Security review, dependency risk, secrets handling, and vulnerability checks.
categories.chinese_description: 用于安全审查、依赖风险、密钥处理和漏洞检查。
categories.risk_of_overuse: May slow minor low-risk edits if treated as mandatory every time.

categories.plain_english_description: Automated tests, UI checks, regression verification, and quality gates.
categories.chinese_description: 用于自动化测试、UI 检查、回归验证和质量门禁。
categories.risk_of_overuse: Can be too heavy for tiny docs-only changes.

categories.plain_english_description: Hosting, release, infrastructure, and production deployment workflows.
categories.chinese_description: 用于托管、发布、基础设施和生产部署流程。
when_not_to_use: The user is not ready to publish
categories.risk_of_overuse: Premature deployment can distract from building the first working version.

categories.plain_english_description: Translation, localization, rewriting across languages, and bilingual output.
categories.chinese_description: 用于翻译、本地化、跨语言改写和双语输出。
when_not_to_use: The task requires external files or app actions more than language work
categories.risk_of_overuse: Native Codex language ability is often enough for short text.

categories.plain_english_description: Drafting, editing, summarizing, README writing, and plain-language communication.
categories.chinese_description: 用于写作、编辑、总结、README 和清晰表达。
when_not_to_use: The task is mostly code, data, or external account operations
categories.risk_of_overuse: Usually does not need a plugin unless tied to document formats or cloud files.

categories.plain_english_description: Evidence-backed analysis, KPI design, diagnostics, reports, dashboards, and charts.
categories.chinese_description: 用于数据分析、指标设计、异常诊断、分析报告、仪表盘和图表。
when_not_to_use: No data or business decision is involved
categories.risk_of_overuse: Do not introduce a full analytics workflow when a small spreadsheet check or a simple explanation is enough.

categories.plain_english_description: Official, current guidance for OpenAI products, APIs, models, Codex, and product-surface decisions.
categories.chinese_description: 用于获取 OpenAI 产品、API、模型、Codex 和产品形态选择的官方最新指引。
when_not_to_use: The task does not concern OpenAI products
categories.risk_of_overuse: Use official current guidance only when OpenAI-specific or version-sensitive information matters.

categories.plain_english_description: Issue tracking, project planning, task workflows, and status updates in connected work-management systems.
categories.chinese_description: 用于连接的项目管理系统中的议题跟踪、项目规划、任务流程和状态更新。
when_not_to_use: No connected project system is involved
categories.risk_of_overuse: Avoid connected writes when the user only wants planning advice or has not approved a specific update.

categories.plain_english_description: Creating, updating, validating, packaging, and distributing Codex skills and plugins.
categories.chinese_description: 用于创建、更新、验证、打包和分发 Codex Skill 与插件。
when_not_to_use: The user only wants to choose a tool
No reusable Codex artifact is being created
categories.risk_of_overuse: Do not turn a one-off prompt into a skill or plugin unless it will be reused.

categories.plain_english_description: Connected Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and similar cloud-workspace content.
categories.chinese_description: 用于连接的 Google Drive、Docs、Sheets、Slides 及类似云工作区内容。
when_to_use: Find or edit a Google file
when_not_to_use: The user only needs a standalone export
categories.risk_of_overuse: Connected access is unnecessary when a local file or pasted content is sufficient.

categories.plain_english_description: Direct interaction with a running desktop application when a file-based workflow is not enough.
categories.chinese_description: 用于在仅靠文件操作无法完成时，直接控制正在运行的桌面应用。
when_not_to_use: A standalone file can be edited directly
The application is not open or connected
categories.risk_of_overuse: Prefer reproducible file edits when they meet the need; GUI control is slower and more fragile.
